body:
Hi Glow Up team,

Your door hangers and cards do a great job. They list your Standard, Deep and Move-In/Move-Out cleanings, your Glow Basic, Plus and Ultimate packages, even your $120 minimum and the fact that supplies are included. But when someone in El Paso picks up that hanger and Googles you to book, there is no website waiting for them, just an Instagram page. Most people will not DM a cleaning company. They book the one with a site.

You have already done the hard part: clear services, clear packages, clear prices. It just has nowhere to live online.

So I designed a homepage for Glow Up Cleaning Co., and it is attached to this email as a PDF. It uses your purple branding and your own tagline, lays out your services and three packages with the $120 minimum up front, and gives customers a simple way to call and book a cleaning.

Cleaning and home service sites are my specialty. I built the website for EnviroClean (envirocleanws.com), a cleaning company, including a custom chat and a system that captures every lead. I also built Just Junk's site (justjunk.com), a home service company, around clear services and easy booking.

If you like it, I can build it for real on your own domain. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas.

Best,
Hassan
name: GLOW UP CLEAN
subject: ✨ Your cleaning packages are printed on flyers, but not online
